p.title: v59.99 the screener no longer empties 31 days after a universe review
p.symptom: From 2026-11-12 the screener's default view showed '조건에 맞는 종목이 없습니다' with 822 ranked US stocks and 0 displayed (the same for 한국), on the live site and in five browser gates.
p.root_cause: The six identity fields (symbol, name, market, MIC, currency, asset type) carried a 30-day freshness budget measured from the universe's lastBulkUpdate. On day 31 every row's identity.symbol was STALE, the required-field audit marked every row not eligible, and the default screen passed none.
p.fix: src/data/contracts/screener.js: identity fields are reference data with no clock budget (cadence 'reference'); a lapsed universe review is still reported once for the page through universeFreshnessStatus.
p.violated_rule: P1542: a lapsed review window is shown honestly and never removes the product's content.
p.prevention: ci-screener-workbench-contract: identity fields observed 400 days ago are not STALE; the news fixture of the chat prompt gate is dated from the real clock (it aged out of the 24-hour window one day after it was written); the non-browser contracts suite was run with the clock 45 and 120 days ahead — only live-data freshness checks differ.
p.verification: ci-screener-controls-contract (browser) exits 0 again; ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check exits 0 today and with the clock 40 days ahead.

changelog: **The screener shows its stocks again ({P}):** symbol and name fields expired with the 30-day universe review window, so from 2026-11-12 every row was unusable and the default view was empty.
note: v59.99: identity fields have no clock budget
